background_story: Avyaan was a young apprentice to the village's revered baker, Master Kumar. In the small town of Ashoka, Master Kumar's bakery was famous for its delectable naan bread, and Avyaan was determined to learn the secrets of the perfect masa. For months, he worked tirelessly, kneading dough and experimenting with different flours. Avyaan's dedication paid off when he created a revolutionary new masa recipe that combined traditional Indian spices with a hint of modern flair. The villagers raved about the new bread, and soon, people were coming from all over to taste Avyaan's creations. Master Kumar, proud of his protégé, handed over the reins of the bakery to Avyaan, who continued to innovate and push the boundaries of traditional Indian baking.
